selection.selection_rule: Highest validation macro F1; tie broken by lower validation cross entropy.

protocol.preprocessing: RGB float32 [0,1]; bilinear resize with padding to 172x172; entire clip at 5 fps if <=10 sec, centered contiguous 10-second window otherwise.
protocol.selection: All 324 clips from the six fixed training subjects: 18 per class, 54 per subject and 108 per repetition. Includes both earlier nested subsets. Validation and test subjects unchanged.
protocol.head: Frozen official 480-dimensional pooled A0 backbone endpoint; train-only feature standardization; dropout(0.25); Dense(18) logits with L2 regularization. No training of backbone or original Kinetics classifier.
protocol.training: Adam(learning_rate=0.001), batch size 16, maximum 200 epochs, patience 25; three prespecified L2 strengths [0.0001,0.001,0.01]; checkpoint and candidate selection by validation macro F1, then validation cross entropy. Test evaluated once for selected candidate.
protocol.augmentation: No video augmentation in this first frozen-feature baseline. Head dropout during training only.
protocol.limitations: One researcher-defined subject split; earlier test results already observed. This is a planned comparison on the same test set, not a newly blind test. No backbone fine-tuning or cross-validation.
protocol.comparison: Prespecified increase to the full training split only. Same input policy, frozen backbone, head, seed, optimizer and validation-only selection. Head initialized afresh; normalization fitted on 324 training clips only.

evaluation.limitation: Single subject-disjoint split; not cross-validation or a published benchmark result.

role: Historical TensorFlow CPU result, contextual only; no new test feature access.
